title: Authenticated mobile date range drawer evidence capture

auth.notes: Uses the first seeded user from the target repo's database.json.

input.note: Capture an authenticated mobile transaction-feed state with the date range drawer open.

steps: Log in with a seeded local user
Open the date range filter drawer
Capture the resulting mobile UI state and evidence bundle

mustPass: The user can authenticate through the local app
The mobile date range drawer or calendar is visible
Trace, screenshot, AX tree, and DOM snapshot are present

assertions.name: calendar container is within the mobile viewport
calendar starts near top of the mobile viewport
no unexpected console errors appear during drawer verification

expectedFailures: calendar starts near top of the mobile viewport
